title: Git source publication and autobuilder discipline
summary: The maintainable Wire UI Swing source authority is the reviewed Git tree on main. Autobuilder consumes Git source/tests/scripts; sealed ZIPs are reproducibility evidence. Do not carry stale compiled JARs forward as source or use a feature branch as the continuation point after it is merged.
invariants: Continue from the newest qualified packages/wire_ui_swing_v0.2-devN tree on main.
Autobuilder input is Git source, tests, scripts and qualification evidence; a sealed ZIP is evidence/distribution, not the edit path.
Do not copy inherited dist/build binaries into a new source package unless that binary is explicitly owned and qualified as a deliverable.
Feature branches are staging points; after merge, main is the continuation source.
Use lease-protected Git operations or PR merge so concurrent project/autobuilder commits are preserved.
Fresh-unpack validation must reconstruct the executable from source and rerun the package gates.

provenance.claim: dev13 removed inherited stale binary packaging and qualified the Git-first source publication path.
